subject: Mutual action plan & implementation cadence — Lumina go-live planning
messages:
From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@lumina.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumina.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow up: Draft MAP & timing

Hannah — thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Attached is the internal kickoff notes from our side and a proposed timeline. High-level asks from Lumina: (1) ensure staging ingest supports incremental snapshots, (2) confirm SSO window for 3rd week of August, and (3) a firm target for pilot telemetry retention. We are aiming for a constrained go-live no later than 2028-09-15.

Two questions that would help us lock dates:
- Can Redwood commit an engineer for the data ingest verification week of 8/6?
- Is a 2-week canary enough to validate performance for our expected 500 req/s peak?

I attached a simple Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — would appreciate Hannah/Ben’s updates in-line.

Thanks,
Jake
Senior Product Manager, Lumina.ai

Attachments: Lumina internal kickoff notes.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow up: Draft MAP & timing

Jake — appreciated the call. I’ve pulled the MAP into a shared workbook (link below) and sketched a phased cadence that balances your go-live target with our QA windows. High level changes I propose:
- Data ingest verification: Redwood will provide a dedicated infra engineer for 8/6–8/10. Owner: Ben Carter.
- SSO: we suggest planning the initial SSO cutover on 8/20 (week of 8/20) with a follow-up validation on 8/27. Owner: Lumina (Sofia) + Redwood infra (Ben).
- Canary length: recommend 3 weeks (8/21–9/11) given traffic shape; this gives an extra buffer for edge-case monitoring.

I attached the updated MAP and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review. Can you confirm procurement timelines so we can lock the staging window?

On internal note: @Ben — please review the ingest checklist and confirm resource availability. @Marissa — please add CS success milestones and acceptance criteria into the runbook.

Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Lumina/Map_v1

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Lumina_MAP_v1.xlsx; SOW_Lumina_Draft_2028-07-24.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -07:00

On Tue, Jul 24, 2028 at 09:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I’ve pulled the MAP into a shared workbook...

Hannah — confirmed: I’m available for the 8/6–8/10 data ingest verification. I’ll schedule a 90-minute block on 8/6 with Lumina’s infra to run the snapshot-to-staging smoke tests and a follow-up validation run on 8/9. Deliverables from Redwood infra for that week:
- Smoke test checklist (completed)
- Ingest latency baseline (metrics collected)
- KV-cache warmup script deployed to staging

On the canary duration: 3 weeks is reasonable. I’ll prep a performance gate checklist (throughput, 95p latency, error-rate thresholds) and add it to the MAP.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumina.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Turner <jake.turner@lumina.ai>, Lumina.ai Procurement <procurement@lumina.ai>

Thanks all — procurement here has two quick asks: (1) can we get a finalized SOW by end of day Friday 7/28 to start PO approvals, and (2) a redline-ready contract template would help speed our legal review. Our target is to issue PO by 8/3.

On the technical timeline: 8/6 engineer window works. For SSO we will confirm internal admin availability for 8/20 by Friday. I’ve updated the shared MAP with internal owners on the Lumina side.

—Sofia
Director of IT Operations | Lumina.ai

Sofia — understood. We’ll aim to deliver a redline-ready SOW and the updated MAP by end of day Friday 7/28. Action summary below for clarity: 

- 7/28 EOD: Redwood delivers finalized SOW (Hannah) + redline-ready contract template (legal)
- 8/03: Lumina to issue PO (Lumina Procurement)
- 8/06–8/10: Data ingest verification (Ben, Redwood infra)
- 8/20: Initial SSO cutover window (Sofia + Ben)
- 8/21–9/11: 3-week canary / pilot (Lumina ops + Redwood infra + CS)
- 9/12–9/15: Final go/no-go window and planned full go-live (target 9/15)

I’ve added owners and acceptance gates into the shared MAP. If Lumina confirms PO target of 8/3 we’ll reserve the staging GPU pool for the 8/6 window. Otherwise we’ll need to move dates.

Thanks — please reply only for changes/blocks so we can keep the MAP rhythmic.

Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
